messages.subject: Question about the multichip models
parts:
I have a set of 500K cel files which have some repeated samples
between batches and I'd like to know if it is okay to throw everything
in at once or is that wrong? Basically my question is about whether or
not the multichip models require independent samples?

Thanks!

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Question about the multichip models
parts:
Hi,

I'm not totally sure if I understand your question - do you have
technical replicates, i.e. the same sample repeated on multiple chips?
There shouldn't be any adverse consequences of doing the low-level
analysis (including fitting the probe-level model) with all chips
together. The copy number analysis is done chip-by-chip, so no
problems there either.

Cheers,

Ken
